mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exam_id = #{examId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_attempt (exam_id, user_id, attempt_no, status, total_score, passing_score, started_at, deadline) VALUES (#{examId}, #{userId}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{totalScore}, #{passingScore}, #{startedAt}, #{deadline})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_attempt WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam e JOIN paper p ON p.id = e.paper_id WHERE e.status = 1 AND (e.start_time IS NULL OR e.start_time <= #{now}) AND (e.end_time IS NULL OR e.end_time >= #{now})
AND (e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR e.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

SELECT a.id, a.exam_id, e.title AS exam_title, a.attempt_no, a.status, a.user_score, a.total_score, a.passing_score, a.is_passed, a.started_at, a.deadline, a.submitted_at FROM exam_attempt a JOIN exam e ON e.id = a.exam_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.started_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.pageSize}
